svg.title: Reading GPU performance signals
svg.desc: A three-stage diagnostic flow from broad GPU activity, through execution resource metrics, to useful workload outcomes.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Start broad, then validate with workload outcomes
Busy time within a sample window
Are warps active on the SMs?
What is the kernel actually doing?
does not prove peak compute or useful model throughput.
Activity tells you where to look. Outcomes tell you whether performance improved.
